Subject: Audit firm RFP: SOC 2 / ISO support (shortlist & decision)

Team —

We need to lock down an assurance partner for this year’s SOC 2 Type II and concurrently evaluate a light ISO 27001 gap assessment / certification roadmap. After the procurement screen I ran, two firms look like clear finalists: Northbridge and Starlight. I attached the RFP draft (Redwood-SOC2-RFP-2027.pdf) and a blank scoring sheet.

Asks:
- Please review the RFP and the proposed evaluation rubric by EOD Monday 1/11. I’d like any redlines inline in the Drive doc.
- Suggest any additional vendors we should include (we want max three bids).
- Karthik — confirm whether the timeline below is workable given product blackout windows.

Proposed timeline:
- 1/12: send RFP to shortlisted firms
- 2/02: proposals due (pricing + sample working plan)
- 2/08: finalist interviews / technical clarifications
- 2/14: recommendation to execs + request for PO approval

Priority criteria (weights in scoring sheet): experience with scale SaaS infra (40%), pricing & fees (25%), availability to start (15%), references / quality (20%).

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-RFP-2027.pdf (draft), audit-bid-comparison.xlsx (blank). Drive link in footer.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement (interim)

Hi Olivia / Starlight team —

Attached is Redwood Inference’s RFP for SOC 2 Type II (period: 2027-01-01 -> 2027-12-31) and a short pricing worksheet. We’re asking shortlisted firms to provide:

- A proposed scope and timeline that covers a Type II engagement covering in-scope services (API, Hosted Inference, Dedicated).
- Fixed-fee bid plus optional hourly rates for out-of-scope work.
- Approach to evidence collection (agents, logs, host-based data) and any tooling you require from our side.
- Two client references with similar scale and cloud architecture.

Key dates:
- Questions due: 1/20
- Proposals due: 2/02
- Finalist interviews: week of 2/08

Drive link for supporting artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcRFP
Doc names attached: Redwood-SOC2-RFP-2027.pdf, audit-bid-comparison.xlsx

Please confirm receipt and whether you intend to bid.

Regards,

Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood RFP: SOC 2 Type II & ISO 27001 gap assessment (proposal request)

Marissa —

Thanks for sending the RFP. Northbridge confirms we will bid and have attached our proposal (Northbridge-Proposal-Redwood-2027.pdf) and a filled pricing worksheet. High-level summary:

- Proposed fixed fee for SOC 2 Type II (period 2027): $78,000 (includes up to 40 hours of remediation support).
- ISO 27001 gap assessment / roadmap (optional): $12,000.
- Proposed start date: 2/15 (onboarding + evidence mapping), fieldwork: 3/07-3/18, draft report 4/01.
- We include a cloud architecture orientation and one onsite visit for key interviews (if needed).

Notes / clarifications:
- We require read-only access to CloudTrail, S3 access logs, and service account token inventory for evidence sampling.
- Pricing excludes any third-party licensing and is valid for 30 days.

I’m available for the finalist slot on 2/09 or 2/10 for a 45-minute technical walk-through.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Principal, Assurance Services
Northbridge Assurance

Aditya —

Recommendation: proceed with Northbridge for the SOC 2 Type II renewal and optional ISO gap assessment. Summary rationale:
- Stronger technical fit for our infra (experience with high-throughput inference platforms).
- Faster start date (can onboard 2/15) and more transparent fixed-fee pricing.
- References checked by Laura were positive on evidence handling and time-to-deliver.

Financials: fixed-fee $78k (SOC 2), optional ISO assessment $12k. All pricing in the attached proposal.

Next steps (if approved by execs):
1) Authorize PO via DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/1234abcdef
2) Kickoff call w/ Northbridge week of 2/22 (Laura to lead technical kickoff).
3) Share required read-only cloud artifacts w/ Olivia by 2/18.

Please reply with OK to proceed or note any objection by COB 2/18 so we can sign and secure the 2/15 start.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement (interim)
Redwood Inference
